contentSummary: Fitness and health are important for keeping our bodies strong and active. In this lesson, learners will enjoy different movements such as running, jumping, climbing, and deep breathing to help improve their physical strength and overall health. Learners will also learn how to use simple playground and indoor equipment safely.

contentSummary: Gymnastics is a fun way to make our bodies strong and flexible. Learners will perform simple tumbling activities such as forward rolls and frog jumps, as well as stunt movements like squatting, balancing, and arm and leg rolling. These activities improve coordination and help learners become more aware of how their bodies move.

SUMMARY This topic is key in helping learners explore educational gymnastics through tumbling and stunt activities by practicing movements that help build body strength, flexibility, and balance. Also by learning how to roll, jump, and balance safely.

contentSummary: Cultures are ways of life of different groups of people. People have different traditions, clothing, food, language and dances that make them unique. Learning about different cultures helps us appreciate and respect others. Additionally, landmarks are important places in a community, such as markets, hospitals, and police stations. Knowing how to locate them using cardinal points helps us find our way.Specific Competences: 1.12.1.1 Explore different cultures in the immediate environment.

“Do you know someone who wears clothes like this?” Show pictures of people in different traditional clothes or eating different foods.ACTIVITY 2: Telling Stories about Different Cultures Learners listen to or retell simple stories from different cultural groups.
